correctness.rationale: Direct proof: at round t shell t and the distant frontier are uniform and distinct. At round two shell-one q-types split by q−2 same-shell neighbours. At round h+1, shell-h profiles are recovered from the h back-neighbour profiles using Σ j_q (j−e_q)=(h−1)j, h≥2. The last shell has one profile. Root-fixing coordinate/symbol permutations act transitively on each profile, preventing extra splits. Sharpness follows from shells k−1 and k in uniform cases, and from different missing-size profiles on shell k−1 in mixed cases. Handles k=1, q_i=2 and all integer boundaries. Actual independent full-graph and weighted quotient verifiers passed 242+7 configurations; finite computations are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Ordinary iterative counting refinement has an exactly determined, alphabet-independent stopping time on every rooted mixed Hamming product, even when the punctured adjacency–degree linear module documented in the nearest primary literature has a smaller dimension than the orbit module. The mixed-vs-uniform depth jump is sharp, and a natural arbitrarily many-factor family is classified; neither arithmetic simplification nor an arbitrary small computation.
